snippet.title: Echo Generation 2 - Official Gameplay Trailer | The MIX | Kinda Funny Spring Game Showcase
snippet.description: Embark on a sci-fi deckbuilding RPG odyssey. Gather your crew, craft powerful decks, and battle across the stars to find your way home. Deal the cards. Defy the cosmos. Embrace the adventure. Watch the Echo Generation 2 gameplay trailer for this upcoming sequel. Echo Generation 2 will be available on Steam, Xbox Series X/S, and Xbox on PC in 2026. The demo is out now.
